brief: Facebook cover image using current gold Flow logo, white background, existing cognition headline and approved earbud design.
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: one finished premium Facebook Page cover image for CYMBA, a consumer audio and cognition brand. Create a very wide landscape banner, approximately 851:315 aspect ratio (2.70:1), at high native resolution, ideally 2553 by 945 pixels. Output the artwork itself, not a screenshot or mockup of Facebook.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 is the approved current gold Flow logo. Preserve this exact flowing open-C symbol and lowercase cymba wordmark, with its proportions and typography. Ignore the empty padded canvas around the source logo.
Image 2 is the locked CYMBA earbud hardware reference. Preserve actual hardware architecture, shape and materials, while creating a new elegant campaign photograph and composition. Ignore its controller and original composition.
Image 3 is the current product hero: supporting reference for the paired earbuds, physical elegance, inward-facing orientation and descending cables.

ART DIRECTION:
Understated, airy, organic premium product design. An almost-white seamless studio surface and background, with the faintest soft warm-white tonal change and natural ambient shadow. Mostly clean white. Gold branding and graphite hardware; no decorative tech graphics. Extremely polished but physically convincing product photography, gentle softbox light, quiet fine metal highlights, no plastic CGI sheen.

LAYOUT:
Use a generous amount of negative space at all outer edges. Keep all crucial artwork within the middle approximately 60% of the canvas width and middle 65% of its height, well away from edges for cover-photo crops. Keep the lower-left corner completely clean.
Place a restrained left-aligned text group around x=29% to x=50% of canvas width, centred vertically at y=45%. At the top of the group place the exact approved gold logo, elegant and modest, not huge. Beneath it add a two-line headline in a beautiful contemporary medium-weight sans-serif, charcoal, with relaxed line spacing and excellent optical kerning:
"The earbuds"
"for cognition"
Keep the gold logo smaller in visual hierarchy than the headline. The entire text group must remain compact with generous breathing room; no little captions, no footer, no URL, no button.

On the right, around x=61% and x=70% of canvas, arrange the two actual CYMBA earbuds as an artfully photographed pair, both complete and crisply detailed, each around 22% of canvas height. One faces outward enough to show its oval graphite faceplate and champagne bezel; the other naturally turns inward to reveal the eartip, with convincing coherent symmetry as a product pair. Slightly different elevations, soft physical depth and a natural floating studio arrangement, absolutely no platform or pedestal.
Thin separate black braided cables exit only from the bottom of each earbud through proper short strain reliefs, descend naturally in gentle relaxed curves, and discreetly continue off the lower edge. They should be fine and secondary, never decorative waves, coils or ropes.

HARDWARE INVARIANTS:
Exactly two compact smoked-charcoal wired earbuds; satin-black rounded oval faceplates with slim champagne rims; soft curved black silicone support fins, plain black with no gold pads; smoke-grey silicone tips on short nozzles. Inner contacts, if visible, stay on the inner shell, not the fins. Materials are beautifully manufactured with clean seams, smooth silicone and subtle smoked polymer, no coarse grain. Preserve reference product identity; no invented form factor, no wireless earbuds, no charging case, no controller or USB-C in this composition.

TEXT IN THE IMAGE:
Only the exact reference lowercase "cymba" wordmark and headline "The earbuds" / "for cognition". No other text. No claim badges, prices, availability statements or watermark.
Output one complete polished image, no comparison board.
status: Generated campaign concept for review and download, not published.

refinement.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this CYMBA Facebook cover with one layout refinement. Preserve the exact gold Flow logo, exact lowercase cymba lettering, headline words "The earbuds" / "for cognition", all typography, headline size and positioning, palette, white studio background, lighting and exact product hardware design.

Change ONLY the product pair size and placement:
Scale BOTH earbuds uniformly to approximately 72% of their CURRENT SIZE, keeping their exact individual shapes, materials, orientation and relative proportions. Recompose the pair into a compact balanced group occupying roughly x=52% to x=76% of the total canvas width and y=25% to y=65% of canvas height. Largest left earbud centred around x=59%, y=42%; slightly smaller right earbud around x=70%, y=49%. The two earbuds must not touch. Their thin separate cables stay attached at the bottom and continue down gently off the lower edge, at the reduced cable thickness appropriate to the smaller buds. Do not stretch either bud.
Leave the entire rightmost 22% of canvas as calm white negative space. Keep the left text group exactly as it is, and keep the lower-left corner clean. Logo and headline must retain exact text and proportions.
Retain the original very wide 2.70:1 aspect ratio and high native resolution. This is a smaller, more spacious product composition for a Facebook banner, not a redesign. Do not add any text, labels, watermark, logo, features, new hardware, shadows under text, backgrounds or effects. One finished image.

output.review: Visually reviewed: correct brand and headline, approved Flow logo, paired wired earbuds, gold and white palette, smaller product composition with generous right margin. No site or social account changed.
